title: Human Primary T Cell Culture Media Preparation
author: Bulent Arman Aksoy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7yihpue
materials: 25 ul of EMD Millipore™ Calbiochem™ β-Mercaptoethanol, Molecular Biology Grade (715 uM)
12.5 ml of HyClone™ HEPES Solution (25 mM)

steps.title: Combine media components
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet, place a 500 ml bottle equipped with a 0.22 µm filter and add the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: Add 500 ml RPMI‑1640 (Corning™ Cellgro™ RPMI 1640 Medium (Mod.) 1X with L‑Glutamine) to the bottle.
Add 5 ml HyClone™ 100 mM Sodium Pyruvate solution (1X).
Add 5 ml HyClone™ Non‑Essential Amino Acids (NEAA) 100× solution (1X).

steps.title: Filter and aliquot media
steps.instruction: Sterile‑filter the combined media through a 0.22 µm filter and distribute it into sterile 50 ml Falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pass the media through a 0.22 µm sterile filter.
Aliquot the filtered media into 50 ml Falcon tubes.

steps.title: Store media appropriately
steps.instruction: Keep the aliquoted media in the refrigerator at 4 °C and protect it from light.
